tier: R01 v2 reviewed merchant-pack tier (sample packs: Best Buy, Target, Costco.com, Apple Retail US)
construction: Constructed by hand by opus-rules-researcher (M2D) on 2026-09-23 from the R01 spec §1–§7 and the merchant passages re-verified verbatim that day (passage hashes in the spec). No merchant-pack evaluator exists (R01 v2 is a wave-3 task); none was consulted.

conventions.fact_encoding: facts.<key> = {type, value, state} per README 'Fixture format'. Keys: retail.merchant_id, retail.channel, retail.purchase_date, retail.received_at, retail.request_at, retail.price_change_at, retail.item_identity, retail.product_category, retail.membership_tier, retail.quantity, retail.unit_price, retail.comparison_offer (observation), retail.prior_adjustments, retail.buyer_is_reseller, retail.target_plus_partner_item, retail.purchase_store_id, retail.promotional_item, retail.promotion_dates, retail.policy_confirmed.
conventions.pack_context: context.pack describes the merchant pack version in force (effective_from, window with `constrains`, discretion, limits). context.pack = null means the merchant has no pack.
conventions.windows: Each window tests the event named by `constrains` (price_change | request | both). Day counting: the anchor day is day 0 unless the passage says the period 'begins the day you receive' (Best Buy: receipt day = day 1). Last day inclusive (assumption). Calendar days are the buyer's local dates (R01 spec §2 calendar_zone). Best Buy's return period 'begins the day you receive' (BB-3): the receipt day is day 1, last day = received_at + length − 1 (R01 spec §5, §7.1).
conventions.temporal: R01 spec §1.4: displayed effective date ≤ purchase → applicable (can reach eligible); displayed effective date after purchase → source_unverified + ask_anyway; not displayed → capped at likely_eligible_missing_evidence with assumption and missing fact retail.policy_confirmed.
conventions.decisive_facts: D147(2): eligible requires every decisive fact user_confirmed, observed, or derived from those.
conventions.refresh: Merchant packs refresh every 7 days; case/variant `source` gives last_verified_on with refresh_window_days 7.
conventions.loader: Same rules as R02-R05 (README 'Fixture format'). File stem R01v2 = the R01 v2 merchant-pack tier; its manifest pack's scenarioId is R01v2 and its rule_id starts with 'R01v2.'.
conventions.conflicting: D152/D154 (README cross-pack rule 3): conflict_kind 'candidates' → different outcomes or amounts = needs_facts; same outcome and amount = capped at likely_eligible_missing_evidence (fact listed in unconfirmed_decisive_facts). conflict_kind 'confirmed_vs_observed' / 'confirmed_vs_confirmed' → manual_review. A conflicting or extracted-only deadline anchor never gives a firm date: deadline.date = null, status disputed_anchor / unknown_anchor, and (user-obligor paths only) advisory_act_by from the earliest candidate.

cases.title: Best Buy own-price drop during the return period; purchase after the policy's effective date; 2 x 12,000 → 9,500
cases.mission_domain_fixture: mission §17 core: two units at 12,000 with eligible matching price 9,500 → 5,000 difference

retail.price_change_at.from: first accepted observation of the lower price

deadline.semantics: return period of 15 days beginning the day of receipt (2026-09-10 = day 1; assumption); constrains the PRICE CHANGE (BB-1), which happened 2026-09-18

justification.reasoning: Pack effective 2026-09-02 ≤ purchase 2026-09-10 (§1.4(a)); the lower Best Buy price appeared inside the return period; every decisive fact confirmed or observed.

cases.title: Best Buy purchase dated before the policy's displayed effective date → known mismatch

expected.user_message: The merchant changed this policy after your purchase (effective 2026-09-02); we don't have the version that applied on 2026-08-25. You can still ask.
expected.note: Plus/Total member (60-day period), so only the policy version blocks this purchase: the captured pack is effective 2026-09-02, after the 2026-08-25 purchase.

justification.reasoning: The captured version's effective date postdates the purchase, so it is affirmatively not the purchase-date policy.

cases.title: Target (no effective date displayed): request within 14 days of purchase → capped at likely eligible

assumptions: the current policy text is assumed to be the one in effect on 2026-09-15

deadline.semantics: TG-1 constrains the REQUEST: bought 'today, or in the past 14 days' (2026-09-15 + 14 days, inclusive assumption)

expected.note: The request falls on day 15; TG-1 constrains the request.

source.note: pack re-verified within 7 days of the variant clock (M09b B.8)

justification.reasoning: No displayed effective date → capped; the window constrains the request date.

cases.title: Apple two clocks: price drop within 14 calendar days of receipt, request within 14 days of the drop (day 14 / day 15 on each)

deadline.semantics: clock 1: drop on 2026-09-15 = day 14 after receipt 2026-09-01 (inclusive assumption); clock 2: request by 2026-09-15 + 14 days

expected.note: the price drop fell on day 15 after receipt — outside clock 1
request on day 14 after the drop — inside clock 2

source.note: pack re-verified within 7 days of the variant clock (M09b B.8)

expected.note: request on day 15 after the drop — clock 2 closed

source.note: pack re-verified within 7 days of the variant clock (M09b B.8)

justification.reasoning: AP-1 limits both when the price is reduced (relative to receipt) and when the request is made (relative to the price change).

cases.title: Costco.com drop within 30 days (discretion clause → merchant decides); reseller; promo item requested after the promotion

expected.note: CO-1 applies to members other than resellers
CO-3: for items with specific sale dates the request must fall within the promotional dates as well as 30 days

justification.reasoning: A qualifying drop under a sole-discretion clause is never a guaranteed amount.

cases.title: Target cross-store and Target Plus comparisons

expected.note: TG-3: bought in a Target store and the lower price is from a different Target store
TG-2: a Target Plus Partner item is matched only against Target.com

justification.reasoning: The comparison source must be one the pack accepts.

cases.title: Only a ShopSavvy history price is lower; no accepted merchant observation

forbidden_outputs: a claim or estimate from the 3,499 ShopSavvy figure

justification.reasoning: ShopSavvy is context only; the pack needs Target's own current price.
Price protection is limited to 10 units of a product.

cases.title: Pack stale, pack record missing, or channel not captured

expected.note: 13 days since the Target pack was verified > 7
X5: no current record for an existing pack
Apple pack exists for retail stores only; the online-store policy page returned 404 (channel not captured)

justification.reasoning: An existing pack that is stale, missing its record, or lacking the channel → source_unverified.

cases.title: Re-evaluation of R01v2-01 after the claim opened

expected.dedupe: identical snapshot → identical result; reuse the open claim

cases.title: Wrong variant or wrong currency in the comparison offer
cases.mission_domain_fixture: mission §17: wrong variant/currency → no false price claim

expected.note: identity mismatch: the offer is for the white variant; BB requires matching model number and color
different currency and not the US merchant's price; never converted

justification.reasoning: No false price claim for a different variant or currency.

cases.title: Excluded comparison prices: open-box / clearance (Best Buy) and a special sales event (Apple)

expected.note: open-box items are excluded from the Price Match Guarantee
AP-1 excludes limited-time price reductions and special sales events such as Black Friday

justification.reasoning: Excluded comparison prices never support a claim.

cases.title: Price adjustment vs return-and-rebuy, with a prior partial adjustment

overlap.note: return-and-rebuy recovers the same difference; never add the two

justification.reasoning: Prior adjustments reduce the ask; alternative paths are not additive.

cases.title: Merchant with no pack at all (The Home Depot)

expected.note: no merchant pack exists (page bot-walled on 2026-09-23); unsupported is not 'not eligible'

cases.title: Apple receipt date conflicts: candidates straddle clock 1, then agree

candidates.evidence: user: 'picked it up from the leasing office on the 3rd'

expected.note: The drop on 2026-09-16 is day 15 under one candidate (outside clock 1) and day 13 under the other.

justification.reasoning: A material conflict on the anchor must be resolved; a non-material one is carried as unconfirmed.

cases.title: Best Buy: receipt date or membership tier unknown

expected.note: the return period begins the day the product is received (BB-3)
the drop on 2026-10-05 is day 26 after receipt: outside the 15-day Standard period, inside the 60-day Plus/Total period

justification.reasoning: The window cannot be placed without the receipt date or, here, the membership tier.

cases.title: Best Buy: user-confirmed receipt date contradicts the store pickup record (confirmed vs observed)

candidates.evidence: user: 'I picked it up on the 12th'

expected.explanation: The return period starts on the day you received the item. You said the 12th; the store's pickup record says the 10th. Check your pickup receipt; the merchant's record will usually decide.
expected.note: D152 5a even though both dates put the 2026-09-18 drop inside the window.

justification.reasoning: Confirmed vs observed conflicts go to manual review.
